you_should_know.description: Far-right influencer and pardoned Jan. 6 insurrectionist Jake Lang was arrested Saturday, according to the Minneapolis Police Department.

you_should_know.title: St. Paul residents call for end to Flock camera contract ahead of city council vote
you_should_know.summary: The fight over Flock cameras could be moving to St. Paul, the capital city, just east of Minneapolis. The automatic license plate-reading cameras continue to spark debate across Minnesota, with some cities cutting ties with the technology, as other cities deal with vandals taking matters into their own hands.
